name: Missing Signer Check
description: When an instruction does not verify that a caller signed the transaction, any account may be passed in its place. Anchor proves this with a Signer field, or the handler can check is_signer directly.

name: Unvalidated Sysvar Account
description: A sysvar passed as a raw AccountInfo or UncheckedAccount is not checked against the sysvar's well-known address, so a caller can substitute an account of their own and control what the instruction reads. Anchor's Sysvar type or an address constraint pins it.
